pob.text: And after you another kingdom[a], inferior to yours, will arise; and yet a third kingdom, of bronze[b], which will rule over all the earth.

public_domain_references.kjv: And after thee shall arise another kingdom inferior to thee, and another third kingdom of brass, which shall bear rule over all the earth.

pob.text: And the fourth kingdom will be strong like iron[a], because iron crushes and shatters everything; and like iron that breaks all these things[b], it will crush and shatter.

spob.text: The fourth kingdom will be as strong as iron.[a] Iron crushes and shatters everything. In the same way, this kingdom will crush and shatter all these things.[b]

pob.text: And as you saw the feet and toes[a], partly of potter’s clay and partly of iron, the kingdom will be divided; yet some of the firmness of iron will be in it[b], just as you saw the iron mixed with clay mud.

pob.text: As you saw the iron mixed with clay[a], they will mix themselves with the seed of man, but they will not hold together, this one with that one[c][b], just as iron does not mix with pottery.

public_domain_references.kjv: And whereas thou sawest iron mixed with miry clay, they shall mingle themselves with the seed of men: but they shall not cleave one to another, even as iron is not mixed with clay.

pob.text: And in the days of those kings[a], the God of heaven will set up a kingdom that will never be destroyed, and the kingdom will not be left to another people. It will crush and put an end to all these kingdoms[b], and it will stand forever.

pob.text: Just as you saw that a stone was cut from the mountain not by hands[a], and that it crushed the iron, the bronze, the clay, the silver, and the gold, the great God has made known to the king what will happen after this. The dream is certain, and its interpretation is trustworthy.

public_domain_references.bsb: And just as you saw a stone being cut out of the mountain without human hands, and it shattered the iron, bronze, clay, silver, and gold, so the great God has told the king what will happen in the future. The dream is true, and its interpretation is trustworthy.”

public_domain_references.web: When he had spoken these words to me, I set my face toward the ground and was mute.
public_domain_references.asv: And when he had spoken unto me according to these words, I set my face toward the ground, and was dumb.
public_domain_references.kjv: And when he had spoken such words unto me, I set my face toward the ground, and I became dumb.

pob.text: And behold[a], something like the likeness of a son of man touched my lips. Then I opened my mouth and spoke, and I said to the one standing before me, “My lord, because of the vision my pains have come upon me[c][b], and I have retained no strength.”

spob.text: Something resembling a human figure[a] touched my lips. Then I opened my mouth, began to speak, and said to the one standing in front of me, “My lord, this vision has overwhelmed me with pain, and I have no strength left.”

public_domain_references.bsb: And suddenly one with the likeness of a man touched my lips, and I opened my mouth and said to the one standing before me, “My lord, because of the vision, I am overcome with anguish, and I have no strength.
public_domain_references.web: Behold, one in the likeness of the sons of men touched my lips. Then I opened my mouth, and spoke and said to him who stood before me, “My lord, by reason of the vision my sorrows have overtaken me, and I retain no strength.
public_domain_references.asv: And, behold, one in the likeness of the sons of men touched my lips: then I opened my mouth, and spake and said unto him that stood before me, O my lord, by reason of the vision my sorrows are turned upon me, and I retain no strength.
public_domain_references.kjv: And, behold, [one] like the similitude of the sons of men touched my lips: then I opened my mouth, and spake, and said unto him that stood before me, O my lord, by the vision my sorrows are turned upon me, and I have retained no strength.

pob.text: So how can this servant of my lord speak with my lord like this? As for me[a], from now on no strength remains in me[c][b], and no breath is left in me.

spob.text: So how can I, your servant, speak with you, my lord, like this? I have no strength left now, and no breath remains in me.

public_domain_references.bsb: How can I, your servant, speak with you, my lord? Now I have no strength, nor is any breath left in me.”
public_domain_references.web: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? For as for me, immediately there remained no strength in me. There was no breath left in me.”
public_domain_references.asv: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, straightway there remained no strength in me, neither was there breath left in me.
public_domain_references.kjv: For how can the servant of this my lord talk with this my lord? for as for me, straightway there remained no strength in me, neither is there breath left in me.

pob.text: Again one with the appearance of a man touched me and strengthened me[a].

spob.text: Again, the one who looked like a man touched me and gave me strength.[a]

public_domain_references.kjv: Then there came again and touched me [one] like the appearance of a man, and he strengthened me,

pob.text: And he said[a], “Do not fear, man greatly beloved; peace be to you. Be strong, yes, be strong.” And when he spoke with me, I was strengthened and said, “Let my lord speak, for you have strengthened me.”

spob.text: He said, “Do not be afraid. You are a man greatly loved.[a] May you have peace. Be strong—yes, be strong!” As he spoke to me, I gained strength. Then I said, “My lord, please speak, because you have given me strength.”

public_domain_references.bsb: “Do not be afraid, you who are highly precious,” he said. “Peace be with you! Be strong now; be very strong!” As he spoke with me, I was strengthened and said, “Speak, my lord, for you have strengthened me.”
public_domain_references.web: He said, “Greatly beloved man, don’t be afraid. Peace be to you. Be strong. Yes, be strong.” When he spoke to me, I was strengthened, and said, “Let my lord speak, for you have strengthened me.”
public_domain_references.asv: And he said, O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace be unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong. And when he spake unto me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for thou hast strengthened me.
public_domain_references.kjv: And said, O man greatly beloved, fear not: peace [be] unto thee, be strong, yea, be strong. And when he had spoken unto me, I was strengthened, and said, Let my lord speak; for thou hast strengthened me.

pob.text: Then he said[a], “Do you know why I have come to you? And now I will return to fight against the prince of Persia; and when I go out, behold[c][b], the prince of Greece is coming.”

spob.text: Then he said, “Do you know why I have come to you? Now I will go back to fight against the prince of Persia. And take notice: when I leave,[a] the prince of Greece[b] is coming.”

public_domain_references.bsb: “Do you know why I have come to you?” he said. “I must return at once to fight against the prince of Persia, and when I have gone forth, behold, the prince of Greece will come.
public_domain_references.web: Then he said, “Do you know why I have come to you? Now I will return to fight with the prince of Persia. When I go out, behold, the prince of Greece will come.

public_domain_references.kjv: Then said he, Knowest thou wherefore I come unto thee? and now will I return to fight with the prince of Persia: and when I am gone forth, lo, the prince of Grecia shall come.

pob.text: But I will tell you what is recorded in the writing of truth[a]. And there is no one who stands firmly with me against these except Michael[b], your prince.

spob.text: But I will tell you what is written in the book of truth. No one stands firmly with me concerning these things except Michael,[a] your prince.

public_domain_references.bsb: But first I will tell you what is inscribed in the Book of Truth. Yet no one has the courage to support me against these, except Michael your prince.
public_domain_references.web: But I will tell you that which is inscribed in the writing of truth. There is no one who holds with me against these but Michael your prince.
public_domain_references.asv: But I will tell thee that which is inscribed in the writing of truth: and there is none that holdeth with me against these, but Michael your prince.
public_domain_references.kjv: But I will shew thee that which is noted in the scripture of truth: and [there is] none that holdeth with me in these things, but Michael your prince.

pob.text: And as for me[a], in the first year of Darius the Mede[b], I stood up to strengthen and be a fortress to him.

spob.text: As for me, in the first year of Darius the Mede, I took my stand to strengthen him and be his fortress.

public_domain_references.bsb: “And I, in the first year of Darius the Mede, stood up to strengthen and protect him.
public_domain_references.web: “As for me, in the first year of Darius the Mede, I stood up to confirm and strengthen him.
public_domain_references.asv: And as for me, in the first year of Darius the Mede, I stood up to confirm and strengthen him.
public_domain_references.kjv: Also I in the first year of Darius the Mede, [even] I, stood to confirm and to strengthen him.

pob.text: And now I will tell you the truth: behold[a], three more kings will arise for Persia, and the fourth will become far richer than all of them; and when he becomes strong through his riches[c][b], he will stir up everyone against the kingdom of Greece.

spob.text: Now I will tell you the truth. Take note: three more kings will rise to power for Persia. A fourth king will become far richer than all the others. When his wealth makes him powerful, he will stir everyone into action against the kingdom of Greece.

public_domain_references.bsb: Now then, I will tell you the truth: Three more kings will arise in Persia, and then a fourth, who will be far richer than all the others. By the power of his wealth, he will stir up everyone against the kingdom of Greece.
public_domain_references.web: “Now I will show you the truth. Behold, three more kings will stand up in Persia. The fourth will be far richer than all of them. When he has grown strong through his riches, he will stir up all against the realm of Greece.
public_domain_references.asv: And now will I show thee the truth. Behold, there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia; and the fourth shall be far richer than they all: and when he is waxed strong through his riches, he shall stir up all against the realm of Greece.
public_domain_references.kjv: And now will I shew thee the truth. Behold, there shall stand up yet three kings in Persia; and the fourth shall be far richer than [they] all: and by his strength through his riches he shall stir up all against the realm of Grecia.

pob.text: Then a mighty king will arise[a], and he will rule with great dominion and do as he pleases.

spob.text: Then a mighty king will rise to power. He will rule with great power and do whatever he pleases.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then a mighty king will arise, who will rule with great authority and do as he pleases.
public_domain_references.web: A mighty king will stand up, who will rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.
public_domain_references.asv: And a mighty king shall stand up, that shall rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.
public_domain_references.kjv: And a mighty king shall stand up, that shall rule with great dominion, and do according to his will.

pob.text: And as soon as he has arisen[a], his kingdom will be broken and divided toward the four winds of heaven, but not to his posterity, and not according to the dominion with which he ruled[b]; for his kingdom will be uprooted and given to others besides these.

spob.text: As soon as he rises to power, his kingdom will be broken apart and divided in every direction, toward the four winds of heaven. It will not pass to his descendants, and those who receive it will not have the power he had. His kingdom will be uprooted and given to other people besides these.

public_domain_references.bsb: But as soon as he is established, his kingdom will be broken up and parceled out toward the four winds of heaven. It will not go to his descendants, nor will it have the authority with which he ruled, because his kingdom will be uprooted and given to others.
public_domain_references.web: When he stands up, his kingdom will be broken and will be divided toward the four winds of the sky, but not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion with which he ruled; for his kingdom will be plucked up, even for others besides these.
public_domain_references.asv: And when he shall stand up, his kingdom shall be broken, and shall be divided toward the four winds of heaven, but not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion wherewith he ruled; for his kingdom shall be plucked up, even for others besides these.
public_domain_references.kjv: And when he shall stand up, his kingdom shall be broken, and shall be divided toward the four winds of heaven; and not to his posterity, nor according to his dominion which he ruled: for his kingdom shall be plucked up, even for others beside those.

pob.text: Then the king of the South will grow strong[a], but one of his commanders will grow stronger than he and will rule, and his dominion will be a great dominion.

spob.text: Then the king of the South will become powerful. But one of his commanders will become even more powerful than he is and will rule over a vast realm.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: The king of the South will grow strong, but one of his commanders will grow even stronger and will rule his own kingdom with great authority.
public_domain_references.web: “The king of the south will be strong. One of his princes will become stronger than him, and have dominion. His dominion will be a great dominion.
public_domain_references.asv: And the king of the south shall be strong, and [one] of his princes; and he shall be strong above him, and have dominion; his dominion shall be a great dominion.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ And the king of the south shall be strong, and [one] of his princes; and he shall be strong above him, and have dominion; his dominion [shall be] a great dominion.

pob.text: At the end of years they will join together[a], and the daughter of the king of the South will come to the king of the North to make an agreement. But she will not retain the strength of her arm, and he and his arm will not stand; and she will be given up, along with those who brought her, and the one who fathered her[b], and the one who supported her in those times.

spob.text: After some years, the two kings will form an alliance. The daughter of the king of the South will go to the king of the North to make an agreement.[a] But her arm will lose its strength, and neither the king nor his power will endure. She will be handed over, along with those who brought her, her father,[b] and the one who supported her in those times.

public_domain_references.kjv: And in the end of years they shall join themselves together; for the king’s daughter of the south shall come to the king of the north to make an agreement: but she shall not retain the power of the arm; neither shall he stand, nor his arm: but she shall be given up, and they that brought her, and he that begat her, and he that strengthened her in [these] times.

pob.text: And one from a branch of her roots shall arise in his place[a], and he shall come against the army and enter the fortress of the king of the north[d][c][b], and he shall act against them and prevail.

spob.text: Someone from her family line will arise in his place. He will move against the army, enter the fortress of the king of the north, and take action against them. He will prevail.

public_domain_references.bsb: But one from her family line will rise up in his place, come against the army of the king of the North, and enter his fortress, fighting and prevailing.
public_domain_references.web: “But out of a shoot from her roots one will stand up in his place, who will come to the army and will enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and will deal against them and will prevail.
public_domain_references.asv: But out of a shoot from her roots shall one stand up in his place, who shall come unto the army, and shall enter into the fortress of the king of the north, and shall deal against them, and shall prevail.

pob.text: He will also carry off to Egypt their gods[a], with their cast images and with their precious vessels of silver and gold, as plunder; and for some years he will stand aloof from the king of the north.

public_domain_references.web: He will also carry their gods with their molten images, and with their goodly vessels of silver and of gold, captive into Egypt. He will refrain some years from the king of the north.
public_domain_references.asv: And also their gods, with their molten images, [and] with their goodly vessels of silver and of gold, shall he carry captive into Egypt; and he shall refrain some years from the king of the north.
public_domain_references.kjv: And shall also carry captives into Egypt their gods, with their princes, [and] with their precious vessels of silver and of gold; and he shall continue [more] years than the king of the north.

pob.text: Then he will come into the realm of the king of the South[a], but he will return to his own land.

spob.text: Then he will come into the land ruled by the king of the South, but he will go back to his own land.

public_domain_references.kjv: So the king of the south shall come into [his] kingdom, and shall return into his own land.

pob.text: His sons will stir themselves up and assemble a multitude of great forces[a], and one will certainly come and overflow and pass through[b]; then he will return and stir up war as far as his fortress.

public_domain_references.bsb: But his sons will stir up strife and assemble a great army, which will advance forcefully, sweeping through like a flood, and will again carry the battle as far as his fortress.
public_domain_references.web: His sons will wage war, and will assemble a multitude of great forces which will come on, and overflow, and pass through. They will return and wage war, even to his fortress.

public_domain_references.kjv: But his sons shall be stirred up, and shall assemble a multitude of great forces: and [one] shall certainly come, and overflow, and pass through: then shall he return, and be stirred up, [even] to his fortress.

pob.text: Then the king of the South will become enraged and go out and fight with him[a], with the king of the North; and he will raise up a great multitude[c][b], but the multitude will be given into his hand.

spob.text: Then the king of the South will become enraged. He will go out and fight against the king of the North. The king of the North will raise a vast army, but that army will be handed over into the hands of the king of the South.

public_domain_references.bsb: In a rage, the king of the South will march out to fight the king of the North, who will raise a large army, but it will be delivered into the hand of his enemy.
public_domain_references.web: “The king of the south will be moved with anger and will come out and fight with him, even with the king of the north. He will send out a great multitude, and the multitude will be given into his hand.
public_domain_references.asv: And the king of the south shall be moved with anger, and shall come forth and fight with him, even with the king of the north; and he shall set forth a great multitude, and the multitude shall be given into his hand.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the king of the south shall be moved with choler, and shall come forth and fight with him, [even] with the king of the north: and he shall set forth a great multitude; but the multitude shall be given into his hand.

pob.text: And when the multitude is carried away[a], his heart will be lifted up, and he will cast down tens of thousands[c][b], but he will not prevail.

public_domain_references.kjv: [And] when he hath taken away the multitude, his heart shall be lifted up; and he shall cast down [many] ten thousands: but he shall not be strengthened [by it].

pob.text: Then the king of the north will return and raise a multitude greater than the former one[a]; and at the end of the times, after some years[c][b], he will surely come with a great army and with much equipment.

spob.text: Then the king of the north will return. He will gather a larger force than the one he had before. After some years have passed, at the end of the times, he will certainly come with a great army and plenty of equipment.[a]

public_domain_references.asv: And the king of the north shall return, and shall set forth a multitude greater than the former; and he shall come on at the end of the times, [even of] years, with a great army and with much substance.
public_domain_references.kjv: For the king of the north shall return, and shall set forth a multitude greater than the former, and shall certainly come after certain years with a great army and with much riches.

pob.text: And in those times many will rise up against the king of the South[a], and the violent among your people will lift themselves up to establish the vision[c][b], but they will stumble.

spob.text: At that time, many will rise in rebellion against the king of the South. Violent people from among your people will raise themselves up to establish the vision,[a] but they will stumble.

public_domain_references.bsb: In those times many will rise up against the king of the South. Violent ones among your own people will exalt themselves in fulfillment of the vision, but they will fail.
public_domain_references.web: “In those times many will stand up against the king of the south. Also the children of the violent among your people will lift themselves up to establish the vision, but they will fall.
public_domain_references.asv: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south: also the children of the violent among thy people shall lift themselves up to establish the vision; but they shall fall.
public_domain_references.kjv: And in those times there shall many stand up against the king of the south: also the robbers of thy people shall exalt themselves to establish the vision; but they shall fall.

pob.text: Then the king of the north will come and heap up a siege ramp and capture a fortified city[a], and the forces of the south will not stand, nor his choice troops[b], for there will be no strength to stand.

spob.text: Then the king of the north will come. He will build a siege ramp and capture a fortified city. The forces of the south[a] will not be able to stand against him—not even the king of the south’s best troops.[b] There will be no strength to resist.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then the king of the North will come, build up a siege ramp, and capture a fortified city. The forces of the South will not stand; even their best troops will not be able to resist.
public_domain_references.web: So the king of the north will come and cast up a mound, and take a well-fortified city. The forces of the south won’t stand, neither will his select troops, neither will there be any strength to stand.
public_domain_references.asv: So the king of the north shall come, and cast up a mound, and take a well-fortified city: and the forces of the south shall not stand, neither his chosen people, neither shall there be any strength to stand.
public_domain_references.kjv: So the king of the north shall come, and cast up a mount, and take the most fenced cities: and the arms of the south shall not withstand, neither his chosen people, neither [shall there be any] strength to withstand.

pob.text: And the one who comes against him will do as he pleases[a], and no one will stand before him. He will stand in the Beautiful Land[b], and it will be consumed in his hand.

spob.text: The attacker will do whatever he wants, and no one will be able to stand against him. He will take his stand in the Beautiful Land,[a] with the power to destroy in his hand.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: The invader will do as he pleases, and no one will stand against him. He will establish himself in the Beautiful Land, with destruction in his hand.
public_domain_references.web: But he who comes against him will do according to his own will, and no one will stand before him. He will stand in the glorious land, and destruction will be in his hand.
public_domain_references.asv: But he that cometh against him shall do according to his own will, and none shall stand before him; and he shall stand in the glorious land, and in his hand shall be destruction.
public_domain_references.kjv: But he that cometh against him shall do according to his own will, and none shall stand before him: and he shall stand in the glorious land, which by his hand shall be consumed.

pob.text: He will set his face to come with the strength of his whole kingdom[a], and upright terms will be with him; and he will act. He will give him the daughter of women to destroy it, but she will not stand[d][c][b], and she will not be for him.

spob.text: He will set his face on coming with the full strength of his kingdom. He will bring fair terms with him,[a] and he will act. He will give him the “daughter of women”[b] in order to destroy it.[c] But she will not succeed,[c] and she will not be for him.[d]

public_domain_references.bsb: He will resolve to come with the strength of his whole kingdom, and will reach an agreement with the king of the South. He will give him a daughter in marriage in order to overthrow the kingdom, but his plan will not succeed or help him.
public_domain_references.web: He will set his face to come with the strength of his whole kingdom, and with him equitable conditions. He will perform them. He will give him the daughter of women, to destroy the kingdom, but she will not stand, and won’t be for him.
public_domain_references.asv: And he shall set his face to come with the strength of his whole kingdom, and with him equitable conditions; and he shall perform them: and he shall give him the daughter of women, to corrupt her; but she shall not stand, neither be for him.
public_domain_references.kjv: He shall also set his face to enter with the strength of his whole kingdom, and upright ones with him; thus shall he do: and he shall give him the daughter of women, corrupting her: but she shall not stand [on his side], neither be for him.

pob.text: Then he will turn his face to the coastlands and capture many[b][a]. But a commander will put an end to his reproach against him; indeed, he will repay his reproach to him.

spob.text: Then he will turn his face toward the coastlands[a] and capture many. But a commander will stop the insults he directs against him. In fact, the commander will turn those insults back on him.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: Then he will turn his face to the coastlands and capture many of them. But a commander will put an end to his reproach and will turn it back upon him.
public_domain_references.web: After this he will turn his face to the islands, and will take many, but a prince will cause the reproach offered by him to cease. Yes, moreover, he will cause his reproach to turn on him.
public_domain_references.asv: After this shall he turn his face unto the isles, and shall take many: but a prince shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease; yea, moreover, he shall cause his reproach to turn upon him.
public_domain_references.kjv: After this shall he turn his face unto the isles, and shall take many: but a prince for his own behalf shall cause the reproach offered by him to cease; without his own reproach he shall cause [it] to turn upon him.

pob.text: Then he will turn his face toward the fortresses of his own land[a], but he will stumble and fall[b], and he will not be found.

spob.text: Then he will turn his face back toward the fortresses in his own land. But he will stumble and fall, and disappear from the scene.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: After this, he will turn back toward the fortresses of his own land, but he will stumble and fall and be no more.
public_domain_references.web: Then he will turn his face toward the fortresses of his own land; but he will stumble and fall, and won’t be found.
public_domain_references.asv: Then he shall turn his face toward the fortresses of his own land; but he shall stumble and fall, and shall not be found.
public_domain_references.kjv: Then he shall turn his face toward the fort of his own land: but he shall stumble and fall, and not be found.

pob.text: Then one will arise in his place who will send an exactor through the splendor of the kingdom[a]; but within a few days he will be broken[c][b], though not in anger and not in battle.

spob.text: Then another ruler will rise in his place. He will send an official through the splendor of the kingdom to collect tribute.[a] But within a short time he will be broken—not in anger or in battle.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: In his place one will arise who will send out a tax collector for the glory of the kingdom; but within a few days he will be destroyed, though not in anger or in battle.
public_domain_references.web: “Then one who will cause a tax collector to pass through the kingdom to maintain its glory will stand up in his place; but within few days he shall be destroyed, not in anger, and not in battle.
public_domain_references.asv: Then shall stand up in his place one that shall cause an exactor to pass through the glory of the kingdom; but within few days he shall be destroyed, neither in anger, nor in battle.
public_domain_references.kjv: Then shall stand up in his estate a raiser of taxes [in] the glory of the kingdom: but within few days he shall be destroyed, neither in anger, nor in battle.

pob.text: And in his place a despised man will arise[a], on whom they had not bestowed the majesty of kingship[b]; he will come in quietly and seize the kingdom by intrigues.

spob.text: A despised man will take his place. He will not have been given the honor of kingship. Yet he will come in quietly[a] and seize control of the kingdom through political schemes.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: In his place a despicable person will arise; royal honors will not be given to him, but he will come in a time of peace and seize the kingdom by intrigue.
public_domain_references.web: “In his place a contemptible person will stand up, to whom they had not given the honor of the kingdom; but he will come in time of security, and will obtain the kingdom by flatteries.
public_domain_references.asv: And in his place shall stand up a contemptible person, to whom they had not given the honor of the kingdom: but he shall come in time of security, and shall obtain the kingdom by flatteries.
public_domain_references.kjv: And in his estate shall stand up a vile person, to whom they shall not give the honour of the kingdom: but he shall come in peaceably, and obtain the kingdom by flatteries.

pob.text: The flood-like forces will be swept away from before him and be broken[b][a], and also the prince of the covenant.

spob.text: The flood-like forces opposing him will be swept away and broken. The prince of the covenant[a] will also be swept away and broken.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then a flood of forces will be swept away before him and destroyed, along with a prince of the covenant.
public_domain_references.web: The overwhelming forces will be overwhelmed from before him, and will be broken. Yes, also the prince of the covenant.
public_domain_references.asv: And the overwhelming forces shall be overwhelmed from before him, and shall be broken; yea, also the prince of the covenant.
public_domain_references.kjv: And with the arms of a flood shall they be overflown from before him, and shall be broken; yea, also the prince of the covenant.

pob.text: And from the time of an alliance with him[a], he will act deceitfully; and he will rise and become strong with a small nation.

spob.text: From the time an alliance is made with him, he will act deceitfully. He will rise to power and grow strong with a small nation.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: After an alliance is made with him, he will act deceitfully; for he will rise to power with only a few people.
public_domain_references.web: After the treaty made with him he will work deceitfully; for he will come up and will become strong with few people.
public_domain_references.asv: And after the league made with him he shall work deceitfully; for he shall come up, and shall become strong, with a small people.
public_domain_references.kjv: And after the league [made] with him he shall work deceitfully: for he shall come up, and shall become strong with a small people.

pob.text: In a time of security he will come into the richest parts of the province[a], and he will do what neither his fathers nor his fathers’ fathers did: he will scatter among them plunder, spoil, and goods; and against fortresses he will devise his plans[c][b], but only until a time.

spob.text: When the province is secure, he will enter its richest regions.[a] He will do what neither his fathers nor their fathers did: he will scatter plunder, loot, and property among them. He will make plans against fortresses, but only until a certain time.[b]

public_domain_references.bsb: In a time of peace, he will invade the richest provinces and do what his fathers and forefathers never did. He will lavish plunder, loot, and wealth on his followers, and he will plot against the strongholds—but only for a time.
public_domain_references.web: In time of security he will come even on the fattest places of the province. He will do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers’ fathers. He will scatter among them prey, plunder, and wealth. Yes, he will devise his plans against the strongholds, but only for a time.
public_domain_references.asv: In time of security shall he come even upon the fattest places of the province; and he shall do that which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers’ fathers; he shall scatter among them prey, and spoil, and substance: yea, he shall devise his devices against the strongholds, even for a time.
public_domain_references.kjv: He shall enter peaceably even upon the fattest places of the province; and he shall do [that] which his fathers have not done, nor his fathers’ fathers; he shall scatter among them the prey, and spoil, and riches: [yea], and he shall forecast his devices against the strong holds, even for a time.

pob.text: And he will stir up his power and his heart against the king of the South with a great army[a], and the king of the South will engage in battle with a very great and mighty army, but he will not stand[b], for they will devise schemes against him.

spob.text: He will summon his strength and courage to attack the king of the South with a large army. The king of the South will meet him in battle with an extremely large and powerful army. But the king of the South will not prevail,[a] because people will plot against him.

public_domain_references.bsb: And with a large army he will stir up his power and his courage against the king of the South, who will mobilize a very large and powerful army but will not withstand the plots devised against him.
public_domain_references.web: “He will stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south will wage war in battle with an exceedingly great and mighty army, but he won’t stand; for they will devise plans against him.
public_domain_references.asv: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall war in battle with an exceeding great and mighty army; but he shall not stand; for they shall devise devices against him.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he shall stir up his power and his courage against the king of the south with a great army; and the king of the south shall be stirred up to battle with a very great and mighty army; but he shall not stand: for they shall forecast devices against him.

pob.text: Those who eat his food will break him[a], and his army will be swept away[c][b], and many slain will fall.

spob.text: Those who share his food will betray him and bring him to ruin. His army will be swept away, and many will fall dead.

public_domain_references.bsb: Those who eat from his provisions will seek to destroy him; his army will be swept away, and many will fall slain.
public_domain_references.web: Yes, those who eat of his delicacies will destroy him, and his army will be swept away. Many will fall down slain.
public_domain_references.asv: Yea, they that eat of his dainties shall destroy him, and his army shall overflow; and many shall fall down slain.
public_domain_references.kjv: Yea, they that feed of the portion of his meat shall destroy him, and his army shall overflow: and many shall fall down slain.

pob.text: As for both of them[a], the kings—their hearts are set on evil, and at one table they will speak lies, but it will not succeed[c][b], for the end is still for the appointed time.

spob.text: Both kings have their hearts set on evil. At the same table, they will speak lies, but this will not succeed, because the end still awaits its appointed time.

public_domain_references.bsb: And the two kings, with their hearts bent on evil, will speak lies at the same table, but to no avail, for still the end will come at the appointed time.
public_domain_references.web: As for both these kings, their hearts will be to do evil, and they will speak lies at one table; but it won’t prosper, for the end will still be at the appointed time.
public_domain_references.asv: And as for both these kings, their hearts shall be to do mischief, and they shall speak lies at one table: but it shall not prosper; for yet the end shall be at the time appointed.
public_domain_references.kjv: And both these kings’ hearts [shall be] to do mischief, and they shall speak lies at one table; but it shall not prosper: for yet the end [shall be] at the time appointed.

pob.text: Then he will return to his land with great wealth[a], but his heart will be against the holy covenant[b]; and he will act and return to his land.

spob.text: Then he will head back to his land with great wealth. But he will set his heart against the holy covenant and take action. Afterward, he will return to his land.

public_domain_references.bsb: The king of the North will return to his land with great wealth, but his heart will be set against the holy covenant; so he will do damage and return to his own land.
public_domain_references.web: Then he will return into his land with great wealth. His heart will be against the holy covenant. He will take action, and return to his own land.
public_domain_references.asv: Then shall he return into his land with great substance; and his heart [shall be] against the holy covenant; and he shall do [his pleasure], and return to his own land.
public_domain_references.kjv: Then shall he return into his land with great riches; and his heart [shall be] against the holy covenant; and he shall do [exploits], and return to his own land.

pob.text: At the appointed time he will return and come into the south[a], but it will not be as the former or as the latter.

spob.text: At the appointed time, he will return to the southern kingdom. But what happens will not be like before or afterward.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: At the appointed time he will invade the South again, but this time will not be like the first.
public_domain_references.web: “He will return at the appointed time and come into the south; but it won’t be in the latter time as it was in the former.
public_domain_references.asv: At the time appointed he shall return, and come into the south; but it shall not be in the latter time as it was in the former.
public_domain_references.kjv: At the time appointed he shall return, and come toward the south; but it shall not be as the former, or as the latter.

pob.text: For ships of Kittim will come against him[a], and he will be disheartened. Then he will turn back and rage against the holy covenant, and he will act[b]. He will turn back and pay attention to those who forsake the holy covenant.

spob.text: Ships of Kittim will come against him,[a] and he will lose heart. He will turn back and rage against the holy covenant, and he will take action.[b] Then he will turn back and pay attention to those who abandon the holy covenant.

public_domain_references.bsb: Ships of Kittim will come against him, and he will lose heart. Then he will turn back and rage against the holy covenant and do damage. So he will return and show favor to those who forsake the holy covenant.
public_domain_references.web: For ships of Kittim will come against him. Therefore he will be grieved, and will return, and have indignation against the holy covenant, and will take action. He will even return, and have regard to those who forsake the holy covenant.
public_domain_references.asv: For ships of Kittim shall come against him; therefore he shall be grieved, and shall return, and have indignation against the holy covenant, and shall do [his pleasure]: he shall even return, and have regard unto them that forsake the holy covenant.
public_domain_references.kjv: ¶ For the ships of Chittim shall come against him: therefore he shall be grieved, and return, and have indignation against the holy covenant: so shall he do; he shall even return, and have intelligence with them that forsake the holy covenant.

pob.text: And forces from him will arise[a], and they will profane the sanctuary fortress, and remove the regular burnt offering[d][c][b], and set up the abomination that desolates.

spob.text: His forces will come forward. They will desecrate the sanctuary—the fortress—take away the regular burnt offering, and set up the abomination that brings desolation.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: His forces will rise up and desecrate the temple fortress. They will abolish the daily sacrifice and set up the abomination of desolation.
public_domain_references.web: “Forces from him will profane the sanctuary, even the fortress, and will take away the continual burnt offering. Then they will set up the abomination that makes desolate.
public_domain_references.asv: And forces shall stand on his part, and they shall profane the sanctuary, even the fortress, and shall take away the continual [burnt-offering], and they shall set up the abomination that maketh desolate.
public_domain_references.kjv: And arms shall stand on his part, and they shall pollute the sanctuary of strength, and shall take away the daily [sacrifice], and they shall place the abomination that maketh desolate.

pob.text: He will corrupt with smooth words those who act wickedly against the covenant[b][a], but the people who know their God will stand firm and take action.

spob.text: He will use smooth, flattering words to corrupt those who do evil against the covenant. But the people who know their God will refuse to give in and will take action.

public_domain_references.bsb: With flattery he will corrupt those who violate the covenant, but the people who know their God will firmly resist him.
public_domain_references.web: He will corrupt those who do wickedly against the covenant by flatteries; but the people who know their God will be strong and take action.
public_domain_references.asv: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he pervert by flatteries; but the people that know their God shall be strong, and do [exploits].
public_domain_references.kjv: And such as do wickedly against the covenant shall he corrupt by flatteries: but the people that do know their God shall be strong, and do [exploits].

pob.text: And those among the people who have insight will give understanding to the many[a], but they will stumble by sword and by flame, by captivity and by plunder[d][c][b], for days.

spob.text: Those among the people who have insight will help the many understand. Yet for days they will stumble because of sword and flame, captivity and plunder.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Those with insight will instruct many, though for a time they will fall by sword or flame, or be captured or plundered.
public_domain_references.web: “Those who are wise among the people will instruct many; yet they will fall by the sword and by flame, by captivity and by plunder, many days.
public_domain_references.asv: And they that are wise among the people shall instruct many; yet they shall fall by the sword and by flame, by captivity and by spoil, [many] days.
public_domain_references.kjv: And they that understand among the people shall instruct many: yet they shall fall by the sword, and by flame, by captivity, and by spoil, [many] days.

pob.text: When they stumble[a], they will receive a little help, and many will join themselves to them with smooth words.

spob.text: When they stumble, they will receive a little help. Many will join them with smooth, flattering words.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: Now when they fall, they will be granted a little help, but many will join them insincerely.
public_domain_references.web: Now when they fall, they will be helped with a little help; but many will join themselves to them with flatteries.
public_domain_references.asv: Now when they shall fall, they shall be helped with a little help; but many shall join themselves unto them with flatteries.
public_domain_references.kjv: Now when they shall fall, they shall be holpen with a little help: but many shall cleave to them with flatteries.

pob.text: And some of those who have insight will stumble[a], so that they may be refined among them, purified, and made white, until the time of the end[d][c][b]; for it is still for the appointed time.

spob.text: Some of those who have insight will stumble.[a] Among them,[b] this will serve to refine and purify them and make them white[c] until the time of the end. For the appointed time is still to come.

public_domain_references.bsb: Some of the wise will fall, so that they may be refined, purified, and made spotless until the time of the end, for it will still come at the appointed time.
public_domain_references.web: Some of those who are wise will fall—to refine them, and to purify, and to make them white, even to the time of the end, because it is yet for the time appointed.
public_domain_references.asv: And some of them that are wise shall fall, to refine them, and to purify, and to make them white, even to the time of the end; because it is yet for the time appointed.
public_domain_references.kjv: And [some] of them of understanding shall fall, to try them, and to purge, and to make [them] white, [even] to the time of the end: because [it is] yet for a time appointed.

pob.text: And the king will do as he pleases[a]. He will exalt himself and magnify himself above every god, and against the God of gods he will speak astonishing things. And he will prosper until the indignation is finished[c][b], for what has been decreed will be done.

spob.text: The king will do whatever he wants. He will raise himself up and make himself greater than every god. He will speak astonishing things[a] against the God of gods. He will succeed until the time of indignation comes to an end[b], because what has been decreed will happen.

public_domain_references.bsb: Then the king will do as he pleases and will exalt and magnify himself above every god, and he will speak monstrous things against the God of gods. He will be successful until the time of wrath is completed, for what has been decreed must be accomplished.
public_domain_references.web: “The king will do according to his will. He will exalt himself and magnify himself above every god, and will speak marvelous things against the God of gods. He will prosper until the indignation is accomplished, for that which is determined will be done.
public_domain_references.asv: And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak marvellous things against the God of gods; and he shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished; for that which is determined shall be done.
public_domain_references.kjv: And the king shall do according to his will; and he shall exalt himself, and magnify himself above every god, and shall speak marvellous things against the God of gods, and shall prosper till the indignation be accomplished: for that that is determined shall be done.

pob.text: He will show no regard for the gods of his fathers[a], or for the desire of women, or for any god[b], because he will magnify himself above all.

spob.text: He will have no respect for the gods of his fathers,[a] the desire of women,[b] or any god. This is because he will exalt himself above all.

public_domain_references.bsb: He will show no regard for the gods of his fathers, nor for the one desired by women, nor for any other god, because he will magnify himself above them all.
public_domain_references.web: He won’t regard the gods of his fathers, or the desire of women, or regard any god; for he will magnify himself above all.
public_domain_references.asv: Neither shall he regard the gods of his fathers, nor the desire of women, nor regard any god; for he shall magnify himself above all.
public_domain_references.kjv: Neither shall he regard the God of his fathers, nor the desire of women, nor regard any god: for he shall magnify himself above all.

pob.text: Instead[a], he will honor a god of fortresses in his place; he will honor a god whom his fathers did not know with gold, silver, precious stones[c][b], and desirable things.

spob.text: Instead, he will honor a god of fortresses[a] in his place.[b] He will honor a god his fathers did not know with gold, silver, precious stones, and valuable things.

public_domain_references.bsb: And in their place, he will honor a god of fortresses—a god his fathers did not know—with gold, silver, precious stones, and riches.
public_domain_references.web: But in their place, he will honor the god of fortresses. He will honor a god whom his fathers didn’t know with gold, silver, and with precious stones and pleasant things.
public_domain_references.asv: But in his place shall he honor the god of fortresses; and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honor with gold, and silver, and with precious stones and pleasant things.
public_domain_references.kjv: But in his estate shall he honour the God of forces: and a god whom his fathers knew not shall he honour with gold, and silver, and with precious stones, and pleasant things.

pob.text: And he will act against the strongest fortresses with a foreign god[a]. Those whom he acknowledges, he will increase with honor, and he will make them rule over many[d][c][b], and he will divide land for a price.

spob.text: He will attack the strongest fortresses with a foreign god.[a][b] He will give great honor to those he recognizes and appoint them to rule over many. He will distribute land for a price.[c]

public_domain_references.bsb: He will attack the strongest fortresses with the help of a foreign god and will greatly honor those who acknowledge him, making them rulers over many and distributing the land for a price.
public_domain_references.web: He will deal with the strongest fortresses by the help of a foreign god. He will increase with glory whoever acknowledges him. He will cause them to rule over many, and will divide the land for a price.
public_domain_references.asv: And he shall deal with the strongest fortresses by the help of a foreign god: whosoever acknowledgeth [him] he will increase with glory; and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for a price.
public_domain_references.kjv: Thus shall he do in the most strong holds with a strange god, whom he shall acknowledge [and] increase with glory: and he shall cause them to rule over many, and shall divide the land for gain.

pob.text: At the time of the end[a], the king of the South will clash with him, and the king of the North will storm against him with chariots, horsemen, and many ships[d][c][b]; he will enter into the lands and sweep through and pass on.

spob.text: At the time of the end, the king of the South will clash with him. Then the king of the North will storm against him[a] with chariots, horsemen, and many ships. He will enter the lands, sweep through them, and move on.

public_domain_references.bsb: At the time of the end, the king of the South will engage him in battle, but the king of the North will storm out against him with chariots, horsemen, and many ships, invading many countries and sweeping through them like a flood.
public_domain_references.web: “At the time of the end the king of the south will contend with him; and the king of the north will come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, with horsemen, and with many ships. He will enter into the countries, and will overflow and pass through.
public_domain_references.asv: And at the time of the end shall the king of the south contend with him; and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and he shall enter into the countries, and shall overflow and pass through.
public_domain_references.kjv: And at the time of the end shall the king of the south push at him: and the king of the north shall come against him like a whirlwind, with chariots, and with horsemen, and with many ships; and he shall enter into the countries, and shall overflow and pass over.

pob.text: He will enter into the Beautiful Land[a], and many will stumble; but these will escape from his hand: Edom, Moab[c][b], and the foremost of the sons of Ammon.

spob.text: He will enter the Beautiful Land.[a] Many will fall,[b] but Edom, Moab, and the chief of the Ammonites[c] will escape from his hand.

public_domain_references.bsb: He will also invade the Beautiful Land, and many countries will fall. But these will be delivered from his hand: Edom, Moab, and the leaders of the Ammonites.
public_domain_references.web: He will enter also into the glorious land, and many countries will be overthrown; but these will be delivered out of his hand: Edom, Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.
public_domain_references.asv: He shall enter also into the glorious land, and many [countries] shall be overthrown; but these shall be delivered out of his hand: Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.
public_domain_references.kjv: He shall enter also into the glorious land, and many [countries] shall be overthrown: but these shall escape out of his hand, [even] Edom, and Moab, and the chief of the children of Ammon.

pob.text: He will stretch out his hand against the countries[a], and the land of Egypt will not escape.

spob.text: He will reach out his hand against the countries. The land of Egypt will not escape him.

public_domain_references.bsb: He will extend his power over many countries, and not even the land of Egypt will escape.
public_domain_references.web: He will also stretch out his hand on the countries. The land of Egypt won’t escape.
public_domain_references.asv: He shall stretch forth his hand also upon the countries; and the land of Egypt shall not escape.
public_domain_references.kjv: He shall stretch forth his hand also upon the countries: and the land of Egypt shall not escape.

pob.text: And he will rule over the treasures of gold and silver[a], and over all the precious things of Egypt[b]; and the Libyans and Cushites will be in his train.

spob.text: He will control the hidden stores of gold and silver and all the precious things of Egypt. The Libyans and Cushites will follow behind him.

public_domain_references.bsb: He will gain control of the treasures of gold and silver and over all the riches of Egypt, and the Libyans and Cushites will also submit to him.
public_domain_references.web: But he will have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt. The Libyans and the Ethiopians will follow his steps.
public_domain_references.asv: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt; and the Libyans and the Ethiopians shall be at his steps.
public_domain_references.kjv: But he shall have power over the treasures of gold and of silver, and over all the precious things of Egypt: and the Libyans and the Ethiopians [shall be] at his steps.

pob.text: But reports from the east and from the north will alarm him[b][a], and he will go out with great fury to destroy and to devote many to destruction.

spob.text: But reports from the east and from the north will alarm him. He will set out with great fury to destroy and to devote many to destruction.[a]

public_domain_references.bsb: But news from the east and the north will alarm him, and he will go out with great fury to destroy many and devote them to destruction.
public_domain_references.web: But news out of the east and out of the north will trouble him; and he will go out with great fury to destroy and utterly to sweep away many.
public_domain_references.asv: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him; and he shall go forth with great fury to destroy and utterly to sweep away many.
public_domain_references.kjv: But tidings out of the east and out of the north shall trouble him: therefore he shall go forth with great fury to destroy, and utterly to make away many.

pob.text: He will pitch the tents of his royal pavilion between the seas and the beautiful holy mountain[a]; yet he will come to his end[b], and there will be no one to help him.

spob.text: He will set up the tents of his royal encampment[a] between the seas and the beautiful holy mountain.[b] But he will meet his end, and no one will help him.

public_domain_references.bsb: He will pitch his royal tents between the sea and the beautiful holy mountain, but he will meet his end with no one to help him.
public_domain_references.web: He will plant the tents of his palace between the sea and the glorious holy mountain; yet he will come to his end, and no one will help him.
public_domain_references.asv: And he shall plant the tents of his palace between the sea and the glorious holy mountain; yet he shall come to his end, and none shall help him.
public_domain_references.kjv: And he shall plant the tabernacles of his palace between the seas in the glorious holy mountain; yet he shall come to his end, and none shall help him.

pob.text: And at that time Michael[a], the great prince who stands over the sons of your people, will arise. And there will be a time of distress such as has not happened since there was a nation until that time. And at that time your people will escape[c][b], everyone who is found written in the book.

spob.text: At that time, Michael will arise—the great prince who stands over[a] your people. There will be a time of distress unlike any since there has been a nation. At that time, your people will escape[b]—everyone found recorded in the book.

public_domain_references.bsb: “At that time Michael, the great prince who stands watch over your people, will rise up. There will be a time of distress, the likes of which will not have occurred from the beginning of nations until that time. But at that time your people—everyone whose name is found written in the book—will be delivered.
public_domain_references.web: “At that time Michael will stand up, the great prince who stands for the children of your people; and there will be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time. At that time your people will be delivered, everyone who is found written in the book.
public_domain_references.asv: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince who standeth for the children of thy people; and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.
public_domain_references.kjv: And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people: and there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation [even] to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered, every one that shall be found written in the book.

pob.text: And many of those sleeping in the dust of the earth will awake[a], these to everlasting life, and those to reproaches[c][b], to everlasting contempt.

spob.text: Many[a] who sleep in the dust of the earth will wake up—one group to everlasting life, and the other to shame and everlasting contempt.[b]

pob.text: Then I heard the man clothed in linen[a], who was above the waters of the river, and he raised his right hand and his left hand to heaven and swore by him who lives forever that it would be for a time, times, and half a time; and when the shattering of the power of the holy people is finished[b], all these things will be completed.

pob.text: As for me[a], I heard, but I did not understand. So I said, “My lord, what will be the outcome of these things?”
